name: Waterside, Marina del Rey
summary: Waterside at Marina del Rey is an upscale open-air lifestyle center featuring premium retailers like Anthropologie and Warby Parker, health-focused dining including Paradise Bowls and Shake Shack, and boutique fitness offerings. Managed by Caruso, this waterfront destination provides a curated shopping and dining experience with organic groceries, pampering services, and contemporary fashion in beautiful Marina del Rey.
demographics: Waterside at Marina del Rey attracts an affluent, health-conscious demographic with above-average household incomes, reflecting the upscale Marina del Rey coastal community. The primary visitor base consists of young professionals and families aged 25-54 with high disposable income, drawn to organic groceries, boutique fitness offerings, and premium dining experiences. The trade area serves both local residents of Marina del Rey and nearby Playa Vista, as well as visitors to the marina and beach areas who seek convenient upscale shopping and dining options. Shopping patterns emphasize lifestyle and wellness purchases, with strong demand for health-focused food options, fitness services, and contemporary fashion brands.
description: Waterside at Marina del Rey is a premier open-air lifestyle center located at 4700 Admiralty Way in the heart of Marina del Rey's picturesque waterfront community. Managed by Caruso, the renowned developer behind iconic Southern California destinations like The Grove and Palisades Village, Waterside offers a carefully curated mix of upscale retailers, health-focused dining, and wellness services. The center features an impressive tenant lineup including the upcoming Anthropologie, fitness destination [solidcore], eyewear boutique Warby Parker, and popular dining concepts like Shake Shack, Paradise Bowls serving acai bowls and smoothies, and Bacio di Latte's Affogato Bar. With organic groceries available on-site and a focus on pampering services alongside wardrobe essentials, Waterside caters to the sophisticated tastes of Marina del Rey's affluent coastal community. The center's commitment to creating a premium shopping experience is evident through its Caruso Signature membership program, which offers enhanced events, early access to offerings, and exclusive rewards for loyal patrons.
